name: password-input
title: Password Input
description: Floating-label password field with an eye / eye-off toggle that cross-fades and spins, a spring-filled strength meter that shifts colour with the score, a live requirements checklist that ticks itself off, and a confirm mode that says when passwords match.
props: Checklist under the field; true uses DEFAULT_PASSWORD_REQUIREMENTS (8+ chars, upper & lower, number, symbol).
Confirm-password mode: shows match / mismatch once the user types.
Passed to FloatingInput: set to false to put the label above the field (no notch) and show placeholder inside.
Eye / eye-off toggle and clear button colour.
Style slots passed straight to FloatingInput — see Floating Input.
Every Floating Input prop (error, success, size, variant, …).
